fluidcompat.configuration.title: Fluid Compat Configs
fluidcompat.tab.mod_compat_list.tooltip: Every mod Fluid Compat works with. Turn modules off or lower their cost if your game lags.
fluidcompat.group.overview.desc: Status of every compatibility module in this game.
fluidcompat.group.auto_balanced.desc: When the server lags, Fluid Compat stretches the intervals of its own optional housekeeping instead of adding load. It never delays the finite-water logic and never changes Flowing Fluids or Create settings.
Small repairs for bugs inside Flowing Fluids itself, applied while the game starts. Each one switches itself off if Flowing Fluids fixes that code.
fluidcompat.notice.unofficial: An unofficial intermediary compatibility mod that helps Flowing Fluids (by Traben, LGPL) understand other mods better. Flowing Fluids is required.
fluidcompat.option.enableFiniteFluids.de: Master switch of the core rules. Off = every machine behaves as without Fluid Compat.
fluidcompat.option.backendPreference.des: Which system removes fluid from the world. AUTO prefers Flowing Fluids when it is installed.
fluidcompat.option.finiteWater.desc: Pumps drain water from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.option.finiteLava.desc: Pumps drain lava from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompat.option.finiteTaggedFluids.de: Also treat fluids in the tag fluidcompat:managed_fluids as finite.
fluidcompat.option.compatEnabled.desc: Master switch for every compat module. Turn it off if you suspect one of them causes lag.
fluidcompat.option.logFileEnabled.desc: Write logs/fluidcompat.log in the game folder.
fluidcompat.option.logVerbose.desc: Also log every fluid intake. Turn on for bug reports, off for normal play.
fluidcompat.option.logThrottle.desc: Minimum milliseconds between two verbose lines about the same machine.
fluidcompat.option.logDebug.desc: Logs a full config dump, every loaded mod, every fluid intake without throttling and every pipe block update. Files get big, use it only for bug reports. Pipe tracing needs a restart.
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedEnabled.d: Turn the automatic slowdown of Fluid Compat's optional work on or off.
Use Flowing Fluids' own tick-time target while its auto performance is not OFF, so both mods agree on when the server is slow.
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedTarget.de: Average tick time above which Fluid Compat backs off (used when it does not follow Flowing Fluids).
fluidcompat.option.autoBalancedMaxSlowdo: Largest factor optional intervals are multiplied by while the server is slow. 1 = never slow down.
fluidcompat.option.ffPatchesDisabled.des: Turns the Flowing Fluids bug-fix patches off. Needs a game restart to take effect.
fluidcompat.option.ffFastInteractionChec: Skips Forge's fluid interaction check (lava meets water and similar) when a liquid block only changed its level. Saves a lot of server time with Flowing Fluids. Reactions between different fluids are still checked in full. Needs a game restart.
fluidcompat.group.mekanism.desc: Makes the Electric Pump really remove the water source it pumps instead of duplicating it.
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpEnabled.d: Make the Electric Pump remove the water source it sucks from, like it already does for lava.
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpWater.des: Apply to water (needs Finite Water in Core). Mekanism removes lava and other fluid sources by itself.
fluidcompat.option.electricPumpDrainLeft: When the pump finds no full source block, drain the thin water Flowing Fluids leaves behind, and water that flows in later. Uses the sweep guard.
fluidcompat.group.mekanism_elements.desc: Makes the Seawater Pump drain the water source below it instead of making seawater out of nothing.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterEnabled.desc: Drain the water source below the Seawater Pump for every unit of seawater it makes.
World water consumed per unit of seawater made. 100 = one for one, 50 = twice as efficient.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterMinTicks.desc: Minimum ticks between two drains of the same pump. 0 = no extra limit.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterShortfall.des: SCALE_DOWN produces less seawater, STOP produces nothing for that cycle.
fluidcompat.group.alexscaves.desc: Makes the Drain move exactly the fluid it takes, instead of counting every thin layer as a full block and pouring out more than it removed.
fluidcompat.option.alexsCavesDrainEnable: Drain through Flowing Fluids and pour out only the levels really removed.
fluidcompat.option.alexsCavesDrainMaxLev: Most fluid levels (1/8 bucket each) one Drain moves per cycle. The original moves up to 64 blocks, which is 512 levels.
fluidcompat.option.alexsCavesDrainInterv: Ticks between two cycles while the Drain works. A Drain with nothing to move or no room to pour waits four times as long.
fluidcompat.option.alexsCavesDrainFillSp: How far from the lowest open cell below the Drain the poured fluid may spread to find room.
fluidcompat.option.alexsCavesDrainEffect: Play the Drain's own sound and particles when it works.
fluidcompat.option.seawaterThinWater.des: Keep the pump running when the water below it is a thin layer instead of a full source block. Needs a game restart to switch the hook itself; this switch takes effect at once.
How many blocks away from the cell above the Drain it may take fluid from. Thin layers often stop short of the Drain. The Drain also keeps checking while it is on. 0 = original.
fluidcompat.group.fluidlogged.desc: Floods listed blocks (the Alex's Caves Copper Valve by default) with Flowing Fluids water, thin layers included, and takes exactly that water out of the world. The block list is edited in config/fluidcompat-compat.toml and applies as soon as the file is saved.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedEnabled.de: Flood the listed blocks from the water next to them.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedLoggable.d: Tell Fluidlogged that the listed blocks can hold a fluid, so blocks without a waterlogged state can be flooded too.
Also tell Fluidlogged that fluid may flow through the listed blocks (only matters while Fluidlogged's own permeability setting is on).
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedInterval.d: Ticks between two checks of the listed blocks that are not flooded yet.
fluidcompat.option.fluidloggedPerPass.de: Most listed blocks looked at in one check, so a very common block in the list cannot cost much time.
fluidcompat.group.immersiveengineering.d: Makes the Fluid Pump finite: no more free water from two source blocks, thin layers are drained too, and no cobblestone is put where finite fluid was drained. The pump hooks need a game restart.
fluidcompat.option.ieFinitePump.desc: Switch off the pump's infinite-water rule for finite fluids and let its area search drain the pond instead.
fluidcompat.option.ieNoCobble.desc: Do not put cobblestone where the pump drained a finite fluid. IE also has its own switches (server config pump_placeCobble and a per-pump toggle).
fluidcompat.option.ieThinFluids.desc: Also drain partly filled Flowing Fluids blocks, which IE's pump ignores. Each gives exactly the levels it holds.
fluidcompat.group.gtceu.desc: Lets the electric Pump drain the thin Flowing Fluids layers its own search cannot see, once its source blocks are gone.
fluidcompat.option.gtceuPumpEnabled.desc: Turn the GregTech Pump compat on or off.
fluidcompat.option.gtceuPumpLeftovers.de: When the pump has no source block left, sweep the thin water around its pump head and give it exactly the levels the world gave up.
fluidcompat.group.pipes.desc: Tells Flowing Fluids that pipes (Immersive Engineering, GregTech, Mekanism and more) stay submerged, and frees the water that stays stuck inside a pipe after the pond around it is gone. Needs a game restart; the pipe list is edited in config/fluidcompat-compat.toml.
fluidcompat.option.pipesEnabled.desc: Turn the whole pipe handling on or off.
fluidcompat.option.pipesNonDisplacers: Pipes do not push water out
fluidcompat.option.pipesNonDisplacers.de: Register pipes through the Flowing Fluids API as blocks that never push fluid out of their cell.
fluidcompat.option.pipesCleanOrphans.des: Remove the water left inside a waterlogged pipe once none of its non-pipe neighbours holds water.
fluidcompat.option.pipesRadius.desc: Only pipes within this many chunks of a player are cleaned.
fluidcompat.group.sweep.desc: Limits for the feature that lets pumps drain thin water. If sweeping costs too much or the server lags while it runs, the guard switches it off for a while.
fluidcompat.option.sweepMaxPerTick.desc: Most sweeps in one server tick, shared by every machine. Lowered automatically while Auto Balanced Compat slows work down.
fluidcompat.option.sweepMaxMicros.desc: If sweeping uses more than this per tick on average over one second, it is switched off for the cooldown. 1500 is about 3% of a tick.
fluidcompat.option.sweepEmergencyMspt.de: If the average tick time is above this during a second in which sweeps ran, sweeping is switched off for the cooldown.
fluidcompat.option.sweepTripCooldown.des: How long sweeping stays off after the guard stopped it.
fluidcompat.option.sweepMaxTrips.desc: After this many guard stops, sweeping stays off until the server restarts.
fluidcompat.option.sweepIdleBackoff.desc: A pump that found nothing waits up to this many of its own cycles before looking again. 0 = every cycle.
fluidcompat.option.sweepReach.desc: How far from a pump the sweep looks for thin water when nothing is next to it. Water farther away is only reached if it flows closer.
fluidcompat.option.sweepScanCells.desc: Cap on positions examined per sweep call when searching beyond the cells next to the pump. Lower is lighter on the server and slower to find far water.
